people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: On the altars he slaughtered all the priests of the high places, and he burned human bones on them. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there, upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them; and he returned to Jerusalem.
